_comment: Cloud providers verified on LordOS (docs/CLOUD.md 19). Only what was really tested: evidence is 'maintainer test: <what>' or 'issue #N'. Every other provider rclone offers shows as Not verified yet, still addable.

webdav.evidence: maintainer test: server/tests/cloud_integration.sh and cloud_providers_check.sh (Check This Account's steps: about, list, folder, 1 MiB up, Free Up Space, read back by hash, delete) against rclone serve webdav, VM 116 amd64, rclone v1.75.2

sftp.evidence: maintainer test: server/tests/cloud_providers_check.sh against the machine's OpenSSH sshd on 127.0.0.1 with a throwaway user and key (key_pem), VM 116 amd64, rclone v1.75.2: every step passed; SFTP has no links

s3.evidence: maintainer test: server/tests/cloud_providers_check.sh against rclone serve s3 (one bucket, access key and secret), VM 116 amd64, rclone v1.75.2: every step passed; links not confirmed (the stand-in gives http:// links and LordOS keeps only https ones)
